sources.scope: 本課「兩奈米以下製程架構」的延伸背景。原子尺度沉積與蝕刻的背景導覽；細部機制以另列的課程技術來源查證。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。

videos.title: Lam：原子尺度工程時代
watchFor: 沉積增加材料、蝕刻選擇性移除材料，兩者需要搭配。
原子層操作著重循環控制；不可把每一循環必定等於完整原子層。
高深寬比及三維結構使均勻性與選擇性同時重要。
watchForEn: Deposition adds material while etching removes selected material; the processes work together.
Atomic-layer methods use controlled cycles; do not assume every cycle necessarily equals one complete atomic layer.
High-aspect-ratio and 3D features make both uniformity and selectivity important.

videos.before: 先問：「MTJ 分層：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence MTJ stack: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「障壁均勻度：建立模型」列為查證任務：局部薄點可能支配穿隧與崩潰；障壁缺口可形成平行漏電路徑。

courses.overview: 從「磁阻式記憶體磁穿隧接面」延伸比較相變化記憶體製作、鐵電記憶體氧化鉿薄膜：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend MRAM magnetic tunnel junctions by comparing Phase-change memory fabrication and Hafnia thin films for ferroelectric memory: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 兩種非揮發記憶皆須平衡寫入能量、讀取窗口、保持及耐久，並考慮選擇元件。
related.transferEn: Both nonvolatile memories balance write energy, read window, retention and endurance, including selector requirements.
related.difference: PCM 以受限體積的熱相變儲存；MRAM 以磁態與穿隧磁阻儲存。焦耳熱在兩者中的角色不同。
related.differenceEn: PCM stores through thermal phase change in a confined volume; MRAM uses magnetic states and tunnel magnetoresistance. Joule heating plays different roles.
practice: 對照相態與磁態兩種記憶狀態圖。
在假設負載下分列寫入、讀取與保持能量。
比較過度編程與磁切換失敗的診斷證據。
practiceEn: Separate write, read and retention energy for a hypothetical workload.
Compare diagnostics for over-programming and magnetic switching failure.

related.whyEn: Both nonvolatile memories balance write energy, read window, retention and endurance, including selector requirements.

related.transfer: 磁與鐵電記憶都利用可切換的內部序參量，能量障礙、保持及讀取擾動需共同考慮。
related.transferEn: Magnetic and ferroelectric memories use switchable internal order parameters, coupling barriers, retention and read disturbance.
related.difference: MRAM 的磁化與穿隧阻值不同於鐵電極化及電容／閾值讀出；磁異向性不能代替鐵電相結構分析。
related.differenceEn: MRAM magnetization and tunneling resistance differ from polarization and capacitive/threshold readout; magnetic anisotropy cannot replace ferroelectric phase analysis.
practice: 分別標示磁化方向與極化方向。
比較破壞性與非破壞性讀取的適用條件。
區分保持失效、讀取擾動及循環疲勞。
practiceEn: Compare conditions for destructive and nondestructive readout.
Distinguish retention failure, read disturbance and cycling fatigue.

courses.summary: 本課以「imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從MTJ 分層、STT 路徑到記憶體用途：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From MTJ stack and STT pathway to Memory application: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
